answer: A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases hence burns capital on every one it does not finish. Because the river deposit is held in the ripple escrow, the orchard audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Opening a challenge costs a deposit of 87 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. That is 23 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
